## About
At R & E Auto Body, our passion is restoration, but there's nothing automotive we don't do. We restore vintage automobiles, build cars from scratch and handle all the mechanical repairs in between.
We work on all makes of foreign and domestic cars, and we're current on all facets of contemporary vehicles. Body work, brakes, transmissions, diagnostics, fleet service. No job too big or too small.
Customers have trusted Carl and the team with everything from a Thunderbird to a Ford Edge to a brand new BMW. We're rated 5 on Google from 68 reviews.

## Services
- Auto Body Insurance Work: We do auto body insurance work.
- Foreign and Domestic Auto Body Repair: We work on all makes of both foreign and domestic cars.
- Vintage Automobile Restoration: Our specialty. Custom and original.
- Contemporary Vehicle Maintenance: We're current on all facets of contemporary vehicles.
- Tires, Wheels, Brakes, Shocks, Struts and Glass: Bring your vehicle in for brake problems, shocks and struts, tires, wheels and glass.
- Transmissions (Standard and Automatic): Transmission problems? We work with standard and automatic.
- Electrical and Computer Diagnostics: Electrical work and computer diagnostics available.
- Collision Repair and Paintless Dent Removal: Body work after a collision, plus paintless dent removal.

## FAQ
Q: Do you work on foreign cars?
A: Yes. We work on all makes of both foreign and domestic cars.

Q: Do you do insurance work?
A: Yes, we do auto body insurance work.

Q: Do you handle fleets?
A: We do. Old or new fleet service too.

Q: When are you open?
A: Monday through Thursday, 7 AM to 6 PM. We're closed Friday through Sunday.

Q: How do I get a quote?
A: Give us a call or send an email and we'll get back to you as soon as we can.
